ideas.title: FBI investigation into Nancy Guthrie's disappearance
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's investigation into Nancy Guthrie's disappearance, including the recovery of DNA from a glove found near her home.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential connections to Medicaid fraud
questions: What are the potential connections between Nancy Guthrie's disappearance and Medicaid fraud?
How is the FBI investigating these cases?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential connections between seemingly unrelated cases and reveal a larger issue with Medicaid payments in Minnesota.
